storage: Keep tightly capped at room temperature, away from sunlight. Some people keep an opened bottle in the fridge to keep the scent fresher. Throw it away if it turns cloudy or smells off.
looksLike: A clear, colourless liquid in a small bottle (100–400 ml), smelling strongly of roses. Many Indian bottles are sold in the skincare aisle as a toner; the food kind looks the same, so the label is the only way to tell.
shelfLife: Varies by brand; the IndiaMART Dabur listing gives 36 months. Check the date on the bottle.
substitutes: A drop of rose essence diluted in a spoon of water

usedIn.raw: 2 drops (optional; offered as the alternative to kewra water, sprinkled over the rice before dum), about 0.1 ml
